Descriptions.ShortDescription: Native USB camera and electronic-lens focuser for Fujifilm X/GFX. Not an ASCOM driver.
Descriptions.LongDescription:
## Fujifilm Native Camera

Direct USB integration for Fujifilm X-Series and GFX bodies in N.I.N.A. 3.2 or later (Windows x64). Uses the Fujifilm X SDK. Original RAF files are preserved.

This is **not** the Fujicom ASCOM driver. Use this plugin inside N.I.N.A. when you want a native camera and, with a compatible electronic lens, a focuser. Use [Fujicom](https://github.com/Scdouglas1999/Fujicom) for Sequence Generator Pro or other ASCOM clients. Do not connect both to the same body.

### Camera

* Timed and bulb exposures up to 60 minutes (T-mode where the body advertises it). A request the camera cannot satisfy fails instead of being silently shortened.
* Abort an exposure in progress.
* ISO from the camera's own list; Auto-ISO modes are filtered out.
* RAW bit depth and lossless compression where the body supports them.
* Long Exposure NR is switched off (and reported if left on).
* Optional sensor crop. Card recording is disabled while connected.
* X-Trans: synthetic Bayer for N.I.N.A. color preview only. Saved images remain RAF; FITS headers include BAYERPAT / ROWORDER.

### Focuser

* Electronic Fujifilm lenses as a N.I.N.A. focuser, including mechanical travel past infinity (SDK over-search range).
* Positions stay in `0 .. MaxStep`. The body is held in manual focus while the focuser is connected.
* Camera and focuser share one reference-counted SDK session.

### Install

Requires the Visual C++ x64 redistributable and the .NET 8 runtime. If you are on plugin 3.0.2.0 or 3.0.3.0, update: those releases capped maximum exposure at 60 seconds.

### Support

Apache 2.0. No paid-only features. Issues: [GitHub](https://github.com/Scdouglas1999/NINA-Fujifilm-Native-Plugin/issues). Optional [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/SeanDouglas).
